sketches.mechanism: Ownership transfer (move semantics) — after giving a value away, the original binding becomes invalid and cannot be used again
sketches.resonance: Once you truly give yourself to someone, you are no longer yours to use; the compiler enforces what the heart already knows.

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — accessing a property through a nil optional silently returns nil, propagating absence without error
sketches.resonance: When the person is gone, every question you ask about them — their voice, their warmth — quietly returns nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The return value of main — returning EXIT_SUCCESS (0) means the program ended without error, yet the program did nothing
sketches.resonance: A life that completes without error is not the same as a life that meant something.
